title: Docker Compose to docker run Converter

seo.title: Docker Compose to docker run Converter — Private, Browser-Based Draft Tool | AafnaiPatro
seo.meta_description: Only plain image-based services with compatible fields are converted; unsupported orchestration semantics stop generation.
seo.h1: Extract standalone docker run commands from Compose

requirements.runtime: browser, compiled via existing lazy route loader

input: textarea and optional file local read
limitations: Multiple-container networking, resource orchestration, depends_on, health checks and advanced volumes are not equivalent to plain docker run.
